text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
I felt a stinging sensation when washing my face, and sure enough, is the skin under my eyes a bit irritated?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Is it from the sunburn?
Which ointment should I put on...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Once I get to school, I should consult Messiah-san.
It'd be bad if taking the wrong medicine made things worse.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Undeterred despite being faced with trouble,
Cesario moved to take corrective action.
However, it seems it will take some time to make a full recovery.
